examples.scenario: Attackers compromise a popular open-source JavaScript library's npm package by injecting a malicious dependency update, leading to a supply chain compromise that distributes malware to thousands of downstream projects.

examples.detection_method: Automated dependency scanning tools detect anomalous new dependencies and versions flagged as untrusted; code signing and package integrity verification fails; network monitoring alerts on outbound POST requests to known malicious C2 domains; static code analysis flags suspicious cryptographic and network communication calls in third-party dependencies.
